CustomField.label: Action Button URL
CustomField.description: Optional URL for a read-only remediation link. Use for docs, playbooks, or Salesforce deep links; do not use it for automatic record updates. Supports {!FieldName} merge tokens (including relationship paths, e.g. {!Owner.ManagerId}) resolved against the record before the link is shown. Stored as Long Text Area (2000) so tokenized report/list deep links have room; the framework validates the resolved URL.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Link users to guidance or a Salesforce page that helps them fix the issue. The link is read-only and may use {!FieldName} tokens, for example /lightning/r/Report/00O.../view?fv0={!Id}.
